超越科氏斑：青少年和成人麻疹中作为新型黏膜疹的类口疮性溃疡

Beyond Koplik spots: aphthous-like ulcers as a novel enanthem in adolescent and adult measles.

中文摘要

麻疹在青少年和成人中重新出现，但其除科氏斑以外的口腔表现特征尚不明确。我们描述了该人群中确诊麻疹的口腔黏膜表现，重点关注类口疮性溃疡，这是一种特征较少的麻疹黏膜疹。 在印度喀拉拉邦一家三级中心进行的前瞻性观察性队列研究（2024年6月至2026年6月），连续纳入年龄12岁及以上、有急性发热和全身性皮疹的患者；报告了通过IgM ELISA和/或鼻咽RT-PCR确诊麻疹的患者。系统检查口腔；在可行的情况下获取溃疡基底拭子，并活检一处溃疡。 在307例发热和皮疹患者中，31例确诊麻疹（中位年龄26岁；31例中30例接种过疫苗，其中22例仅接种过一剂婴儿期疫苗）。任何口腔黏膜发现出现在31例中的21例（67.7%）。类口疮性溃疡出现在31例中的11例（35.5%），跨越病程第3至8天，并且比科氏斑（31例中的13例，41.9%）持续时间更长，科氏斑与更早就诊相关（中位第4天对第6天，p=0.001）。在3例患者中获取的溃疡基底拭子，所有3例麻疹RT-PCR阳性，且单纯疱疹病毒1/2型、肠道病毒、巨细胞病毒、EB病毒和水痘-带状疱疹病毒均为阴性；活检显示非特异性口疮形态。 类口疮性口腔溃疡是麻疹常见的黏膜疹，其持续时间超过科氏斑窗口期，值得主动识别并及时进行麻疹检测。

英文摘要

Measles is re-emerging in adolescents and adults, yet its oral phenotype beyond Koplik spots is poorly characterised. We describe the oral mucosal manifestations of confirmed measles in this group, focusing on aphthous-like ulcers, a less characterised enanthem of measles. In a prospective observational cohort at a tertiary centre in Kerala, India (June 2024 to June 2026), patients aged 12 years or older with acute fever and generalised rash were enrolled consecutively; those with measles confirmed by IgM ELISA and/or nasopharyngeal RT-PCR are reported. The oral cavity was examined systematically; ulcer-base swabs were obtained where feasible and one ulcer was biopsied. Of 307 patients with fever and rash, 31 had confirmed measles (median age 26 years; 30 of 31 vaccinated, 22 of them with a single infant dose). Any oral mucosal finding occurred in 21 of 31 (67.7%). Aphthous-like ulcers occurred in 11 of 31 (35.5%), spanned illness days 3 to 8, and outlasted Koplik spots (13 of 31, 41.9%), which were associated with earlier presentation (median day 4 versus 6, p=0.001). Ulcer-base swabs, obtained in three patients, were measles RT-PCR-positive in all three and negative for herpes simplex virus 1/2, enteroviruses, cytomegalovirus, Epstein-Barr virus and varicella-zoster virus; biopsy showed non-specific aphthous morphology. Aphthous-like oral ulcers are a frequent enanthem of measles that outlasts the Koplik window and warrants active recognition and prompt measles testing.
